events.description: A dark-colored sedan (appears to be a classic Lada) is struck on its right side by a large red-and-black Scania truck while attempting to overtake or cross the road, causing the car to spin and emit smoke/dust; impact and immediate aftermath are visible.

A dark-colored sedan (appears to be a classic Lada) is struck on its right side by a large red-and-black truck while attempting to cross or merge into the lane, causing the car to spin and emit smoke/dust from tire friction.

The camera vehicle collides with the impacted sedan or debris, resulting in immediate windshield shattering; subsequent frames show the cracked windshield with spiderweb fractures and light refraction through broken glass.
A black SUV collides with the front-left side of a white bus at an intersection, causing visible deformation and dust/ debris upon impact.
A silver SUV collides head-on with a white sedan at night; the impact causes visible deformation of both vehicles, smoke/dust emission, and the white sedan is pushed sideways.

A silver SUV makes a left turn across traffic and collides head-on with an oncoming white SUV at night. The impact occurs around 33.5s, causing visible deformation of both vehicles' front ends and generating smoke/debris.
A light-colored hatchback (appears to be a Lada Samara) overtakes on the left and then swerves sharply right, colliding with the rear right side of a white sedan ahead in daylight conditions.
A white hatchback (Lada Samara) swerves sharply to the right, loses control, and collides with the roadside verge or ditch, kicking up debris and tilting its rear wheels off the pavement.
A silver minivan collides with a traffic officer who is standing in the intersection, causing the officer to be struck and fall to the ground.

After being struck and lying on the road, the officer remains motionless on the ground while the silver minivan remains stopped directly over or adjacent to them, with no immediate assistance rendered; this constitutes abuse of a helpless victim in a traffic incident context.
A silver minivan collides with a traffic officer standing in the intersection, causing the officer to be struck and fall to the ground.

After being knocked down by the vehicle, the officer lies motionless on the road while the silver minivan remains stationary directly over or adjacent to them, with no immediate assistance provided; the driver does not exit the vehicle during this period, suggesting potential neglect of a helpless victim.
A person is seen on the ground between a silver minivan and a blue SUV, indicating a recent collision involving the person and at least one vehicle; the person appears to have been struck and fallen.

A person lies motionless on the road between two vehicles for the entire observed interval, with no immediate aid or movement from the drivers; a uniformed officer arrives only at ~68.0s, suggesting prolonged inaction by nearby parties toward a helpless victim.
